error_note: Absolute whiskers: +/- 1 sample SD (spread, not a confidence interval).
relative_note: Relative whiskers: archived paired 95% intervals where available; unadjusted for multiple comparisons.

explanation.observation: The black segments mark the lowest observed mean within each group. Lowest-mean counts on this page: Strassen (selected) 2, Native XLA 1, Frozen rule 3. Archived paired intervals for Strassen versus Native: 3 faster, 2 slower, 1 inconclusive.
explanation.interpretation: The rule was frozen from N5 before these held-out shapes were measured. It chooses Native on 13 shapes, Strassen on 2 and Cubic on 1. All 3 custom routes beat Native in complete-call timing, and those gains repeat on a fresh v5e allocation. Independent comparator tuning did not update the rule. Duplicate Native/rule bars can differ through timing noise rather than algorithmic improvement.
